title: Heavy-Lift Octocopter Platform
description: An eight-motor heavy-lift platform arranged around a rigid circular frame and central payload zone. The supplied sheet targets a 15 kg payload, with motor redundancy and distributed thrust suited to lifting and specialist field missions.
